svg.title: OKHWB v3: chiral hue walks, 1024 colors
svg.desc: Three traversal families, each with its W/B mirror, repeat eight times around 48 source hues. Each cell advances one of 21 hue steps. Sixteen shared grays complete the palette.

g.text: 48 vivid anchors + 960 hue-walk samples + 16 grays · six traversals, eight cycles

svg.text: Hue advances by 7.5° / 21 per cell. Shared gray edge repeats visually; palette stores it once.
